entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Dated : 21-04-2023
 Shri Sourabh Bhushan Shrivastava - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Akshay Namdeo - Government Advocate for the respondent/State.
Ms. Priyanka Jain - Advocate for the complainant.

This is the first application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C filed by the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.163/2023 registered at Police Station - Kohefiza, District Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 &
120-B of IPC.
2.
Applicant is working as Patwari in District Bhopal.
He is apprehending his arrest on the basis of registration of offences referred above.

3. As per allegations, applicant caused mischief while undertaking measurement in demarcation proceedings held in respect of co-accused Ramgopal and others in such a manner that land of complainant Daulat Ram Sahu was compromised and reduced.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that no such measurement has undertaken at the instance of applicant which reduces the area of land of ownership of complainant Daulat Ram Sahu.
He is ready to undertake exact measurement of land of complainant in accordance with law so that real picture may emerge before the Court.

4 . Learned Government Advocate for the State opposed the prayer however, he fairly submits that if appropriate directions are given to revenue authorities then this exercise can be taken so that allegations of complainant can be verified.

5. Learned counsel for the complainant opposed the prayer but fairly submits that complainant is ready to undertake measurement/demarcation proceedings in a manner where exact measurement of land belonging to complainant be verified.

6. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

sentences.text: Considering the submissions, this Court intends to allow the application for bail temporarily, till further orders so that applicant and other revenue authorities can take appropriate measure to get the measurement of land belonging to complainant be done.

It is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority/trial Court.

Note:- SDO and Tehsildar Hujur, District Bhopal are expected to undertake demarcation proceedings of complainant of Khasra No.14/4/2 admeasuring 1.82 acres, Village Bhaisakhedi,
Ward No.3 Tehsil Hujur, District Bhopal within 15 days' so that land of complainant may not be compromised and allegations of complainant may be verified from the revenue records.
List the case on 10.05.2023 for further orders.
